chunks: And Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام said:

"Rajab is a great month. In it, Allah multiplies good deeds and effaces evil deeds. Whoever fasts one day of Rajab, the Fire is distanced from him by the journey of a year; and whoever fasts three days, the Garden becomes obligatory for him."

key_terms.رَجَبٌ: The sacred month of Rajab, described here as a month of great spiritual merit.
key_terms.شَهْرٌ عَظِيمٌ: A tremendous and exalted month in rank and blessing.
key_terms.ٱلسَّيِّئَاتِ: Sins or evil deeds that Allah effaces in this month.
key_terms.ٱلنَّارُ: The Fire, from which the fasting person is distanced.
key_terms.ٱلْجَنَّةُ: Paradise, which becomes obligatory for one who fasts three days.
key_terms.ٱلْحَسَنَاتِ: Good deeds whose reward Allah multiplies in this month.

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting in the month of Rajab?
ai.summary: This hadith praises the month of Rajab and encourages fasting in it by describing its immense spiritual reward. It teaches that deeds in Rajab are greatly magnified, sins are erased, and fasting in this month brings protection from the Fire and entitlement to Paradise.
